note: spaces toolbar -- renders: Mail/Address Book/Calendar/Tasks/Chat/Settings/Collapse buttons; excepts the addons container which may hold third-party addon buttons
unified toolbar container -- renders: search bar control, app menu button, minimize/restore/close window controls; excepts notification popup which may carry dynamic messages
menu bar -- renders: File/Edit/View/Go/Message/Tasks/Help menus, fixed operator vocabulary
chat toolbar -- renders: Add Buddy/Join Chat/Status Type/Chat Accounts buttons; excepts the status message label which displays the user's custom status text
folder pane header bar -- renders: More/Write Message/Get Messages buttons, fixed operator vocabulary
thread pane header bar -- renders: Quick Filter toggle, Display options button, folder count container; excepts the folder name heading which echoes a user/account-derived folder name
message header action toolbar -- renders: Reply/Forward/Archive/Junk/Trash/More/Star buttons, fixed operator vocabulary
offline status indicator button -- renders: fixed online/offline connection state label, closed operator vocabulary
push buttons in message header -- renders: Reply/Forward/Archive/Junk/Trash/More/Star/Add to Address Book buttons, all fixed operator controls; sender/recipient/subject text stays masked
